submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole is a retrospective, form-specific English word-form detector for the seeing/looking family: it peaks on the trigger token itself (79-94% of each peak's integrated-gradients attribution lies on that token, and every occurrence of ' see' (56), ' View' (15) and ' close' (16) in the audit scan is active), firing on the gaze and inspection verbs (see/sees/saw/seen/seeing, view(s)/viewed/viewing/viewer/preview, look(s)/looked/looking/lookout/lookalike, watch(es)/watched/watching/watchful, inspect/inspection(s)/inspected/inspecting/inspector(s), examine/examines/examined/examining/examination(s), check(s)/checked/checking/checker/checkbox, browse/browsed/browsing, scan(s)/scanned/scanning, search/searches/searched/searching, monitor(s)/monitoring, glance(s)/glanced, glimpse(s)/glimpsed, peek(ed/s)/peeking, gaze/gazed, squint(ed/s)/squinting, visit(s)/visited/visiting/visitor(s), tour(s)/toured/touring/tourist(s), sightsee/sightseeing/sighted, lookout, spectator(s)), on the eye and sight nouns (eye(s)/eyed/eyeing/eyeball(s)/eyelid(s)/eyelash(es)/eyebrow(s)/brow(s)/eyesight/sight(s)/visual/visually/visible/visibility/vision/visor/ocular/cornea/retina), and on open(s)/opened/opening/close(s)/closed/closing/closely (weaker, often sub-threshold, on window(s)/tab(s)/preview/browser/scroll and on stare/observe). It is form- rather than sense-driven ('The shop is close to the station' fires as strongly as 'close the browser'), stays near baseline on differently spelled near-synonyms (notice, spot, read, peep, peer, ogle, leer, blink, wink, survey, peruse), on the other senses (hear, listen, smell, taste, touch), on visual-content or gear nouns (image, picture, photo, camera, lens, glasses, video), on web-page nouns (http/www/link/website/page/click/menu) and on aperture words (shut, lock, door, screen, curtain, blind), and its output direction promotes eye/sight vocabulary (Jacobian lens: eye, eyes, gaze, ocular, magnification), so it is retrospective rather than lookahead (zero-ablation leaves next-token predictions almost unchanged: KL 0.003 with no concentrated target set).
